title: AlgorithmToolkit
prompt: Implement `MissingNumber`, `HasPairSum`, and `Compress` — each is one of the module's patterns.

tests.name: gaps
tests.hint: The array has n numbers from 0..n — so n equals nums.Length, not Length+1.

tests.name: pairs
tests.hint: Check `seen` BEFORE adding the current value — that's what forbids self-pairing.

tests.name: runs
tests.hint: Flush the final run after the loop — the last run has no next character to trigger it.
